purpose: Public decorative UI art only. No private story or character media was read or provided.
sharedDirection: Japanese fantasy picturebook; soft watercolor and gouache, thin violet lines, upper-left moonlight; moon-white/iris-violet #7460B5/pale-lavender #B7A2EC; objects and scene, no public protagonist, no writing or portrait.
processing: Pillow LANCZOS delivery downsampling only; RGBA alpha preserved. Generated originals remain in external validation evidence and the built-in tool output. No repainting or silhouette extraction.

themeStrategy.method: Identical transparent artwork in both modes. PageArt uses existing --color-primary for a faint radial CSS support wash. No baked rectangular backdrop, no inversion or recoloring.

accessibility: Decorative span aria-hidden=true, image alt empty; no interactive element.
failureFallback: Image onError sets hidden=true; CSS hides the entire art including its support wash. Wrapper retains its aspect ratio and dimensions; no broken-image symbol or private-media substitute.
licensingNotes: New artwork generated through the built-in tool for the authorized project, without reference photographs or third-party downloaded assets. Use remains subject to the tool/service terms; this manifest does not claim exclusive rights or provide a separate third-party license.

Asset type: public decorative UI illustration for a Japanese fantasy writing app, first of a coherent three-asset picture-book series.
Primary request: "moon bridge and distant lights": an empty, gently arched pale stone footbridge crossing a ribbon of water, a small distant lantern glow beyond it, and a slender crescent moon above. No people.
Style/medium: elegant Japanese fantasy picture-book watercolor and lightly opaque gouache on paper, fine hand-drawn violet lines, soft pigment texture, airy and fresh, gently feathered silhouette edges. Flat painted art, not photorealistic or 3D.
Composition/framing: one isolated wide scene, 16:9 canvas, centered, broad horizontal silhouette that stays understandable displayed at 320x180 and 64x36. Scene islands fade into actual transparent alpha around the whole composition, no rectangular landscape backdrop.
Lighting/mood: consistent soft moonlight from upper left, tiny warm distant lamp accents, quiet anticipation.

No text, no glyphs, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no portrait, no girl or protagonist, no game metal frame, no UI widgets, no symbols resembling interface icons. Produce a finished bitmap illustration.
